verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official MCP server that lets LLMs/agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, etc.) directly interact with Appwrite's API and docs, covering project/resource management and function deployment. This is first-party documented and probe-confirmed, though there's no independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability. Missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and more detail on setup/auth flow.
